story_type: jet demonstration sneak pass, cockpit camera, vapor over the wings
hook: A camera behind a Blue Angels pilot, low over Miami Beach.
narration: This camera rides behind a Blue Angels pilot as his jet pulls up off Miami Beach.
It was the sneak pass, low and fast over Miami Beach.
Those white streaks off the wings are moisture condensing in the low pressure over them.
Then it climbed away, the beach falling behind.
outcome: Lieutenant Commander Andre Webb, the opposing solo, flew it at the twenty nineteen Air and Sea Show in Miami.
title: Blue Angels sneak pass, cockpit view
description:
Lt. Cmdr. Andre Webb, opposing solo pilot of the U.S. Navy Blue Angels, flies the sneak pass during the 2019 Air and Sea Show in Miami, May 24, 2019, filmed from the cockpit.

Footage: U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Timothy Schumaker, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/716031/blue-angels-sneak-pass-through-miami
